children: (NYSE: S) has been named an AI Security Platform Leader by Latio in the analyst firm's 2026 AI Security Market Report. The new report maps key players in the AI security market by use case, spanning browsers, endpoint applications, cloud-hosted agent builders, third-party developer tools, and first-party AI usage.

It’s the latest third-party validation of SentinelOne’s leadership in both AI for Security and Security for AI, empowering security teams with agentic defense. This June, Latio named SentinelOne a SOC Platform Leader, citing the AI-first platform strategy and the integrated data lake. In February, SentinelOne was named a leader by Software Analyst Cyber Research (SACR) in its inaugural Unified Agentic Defense Platforms Majestic Technoscope.

starts where AI runs. AI agents now operate in virtually every layer of the organization, from identities to infrastructure. Every AI attack starts as an interaction and ends as an action. It lands on an endpoint, an identity, or a cloud workload, and SentinelOne acts there. Solving this requires a unified architecture that both creates visibility into AI activity and delivers autonomous, runtime detection and response to AI-related threats.

"AI has significantly changed and expanded the attack surface, and that new risk demands stopping AI threats everywhere AI work happens," said Chris Corde, Chief Product Officer, SentinelOne. "From agents running workflows with trusted access, to employees adopting sanctioned and shadow AI tools, to IT and developers deploying 3rd party and homegrown apps, our customers need security that stops threats without stifling innovation. SentinelOne helps organizations embrace AI, while putting the governance and guardrails in place to ensure AI is behaving and executing as intended.”

Latio's report separates SentinelOne and its strength as a leader in AI-native, autonomous runtime protection from newer entrants. SentinelOne Prompt Security extends the company’s category leading workload coverage to more than 15,000 AI applications and sites. It also reaches the agents, MCP servers, and applications teams build themselves. Latio calls SentinelOne one of the strongest broader AI security options on the market.

Latio is an independent technology research and advisory firm specializing in security operations. The SOC Platform Leader designation recognizes vendors demonstrating comprehensive capabilities across the modern security operations stack.

SentinelOne (NYSE: S) is the leader in AI security, setting the standard for using AI and automation to give defenders a decisive operating advantage. Built for those who secure our world, its platform delivers unified coverage across endpoints, identity, cloud, and AI. Powered by Autonomous Security Intelligence, SentinelOne stops attacks at machine speed, reducing risk and delivering clarity and control to stay one step ahead. Headquartered in Mountain View, California with teams worldwide, SentinelOne protects nearly one-fifth of the Fortune 500 and hundreds of Global 2000 enterprises. From Main Street to Wall Street, the world’s most critical organizations trust SentinelOne with their security.
